proof:
Source: step 3 of the parent proof ("For every i and L^n-a.e. a ∈ A_i, M has the approximate tangent space range Dg_i(a) at g_i(a); consequently T_{g_i(a)} = range Dg_i(a)"). Its four ingredients are the siblings: piece_image_tangent (parts (3a), (3d), (3e): the tangent plane of the piece itself), tangent_transfer (parts (3b), (3c), (3f): locality of approximate tangent planes), piece_pullback (part (3a): H^n-a.e. statements on the piece pull back to the parameters) and chosen_plane (the "consequently" clause). Notation: E := ℝ^P; H^n := μHE[n]; λ := volume on ℝ^n; Γ := g(A).
1. (Piece image.) By the sibling piece_pullback (Submission.ptd_piece_image_measurable_ae_pullback) applied to g, A, L, c: Γ is Borel, and every property of points of E holding H^n⌞Γ-a.e. holds at g(a) for λ⌞A-a.e. a.
2. (Local finiteness of Γ.) Γ ⊆ M, so H^n(Γ ∩ K) ≤ H^n(M ∩ K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ E.
3. (Locality.) The sibling tangent_transfer (Submission.doraggt_ae_approxTangent_transfer) with W := E (open), A := Γ and B := M (both Borel, and locally H^n-finite on compact sets by step 2 and the hypothesis) gives: for H^n-a.e. x, if x ∈ Γ (then also x ∈ M) then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Γ x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q for every subspace Q. As Γ is Borel, this says (ae_restrict_iff') that the property "∀ Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Γ x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M x Q" holds for H^n⌞Γ-a.e. x.
4. (Pull-back.) By steps 1 and 3, for λ⌞A-a.e. a: for every Q, HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Γ (g(a)) Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (g(a)) Q.
5. (Tangent plane of the piece.) By the sibling piece_image_tangent (Submission.idtp_caf_piece_image_approxTangent_ae; hypotheses n ≥ 1, g L-Lipschitz, A Borel, c > 0, the lower bound, differentiability with injective derivative on A), for λ⌞A-a.e. a: HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n Γ (g(a)) (range Dg(a)).
6. (Conclusion.) For λ⌞A-a.e. a both step 4 and step 5 hold (intersection of two conull sets); then HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n M (g(a)) (range Dg(a)) by step 4 with Q := range Dg(a), and the sibling chosen_plane (Submission.dpf_itt_approxTangentPlane_eq) gives approxTangentPlane n M (g(a)) = range Dg(a). ∎
key_steps: piece_pullback: g(A) is Borel and H^n⌞g(A)-a.e. properties hold at g(a) for a.e. a ∈ A.
g(A) ⊆ M is locally H^n-finite; tangent_transfer with W = ℝ^P makes the approximate tangent planes of g(A) and M agree H^n⌞g(A)-a.e.
Pull back this agreement to a.e. parameter a ∈ A.

Hence M has approximate tangent space range Dg(a) at g(a), and chosen_plane identifies approxTangentPlane n M (g a).
